fail_closed.description: Refuse a failed external turn instead of falling back to the platform model. Absent preserves existing fallback.

visible_character.description: An application renders a visible character independently of RTA audio/video transport.

performance.description: Opt in to generation identity and admission/cancellation producer events. Receiver playout synchronization requires audio_output correlated_pcm_v1.

audio_output.description: Deliver correlated 24 kHz mono PCM instead of the ordinary audio track. Requires performance v1, fail_closed true, mode voice and voice_webhook.
